title: Adrenal Care
description: Manage stress levels Supports healthy cortisol levels Support lower tolerance to stimulants Supports recovery from adrenal fatigue Adrenal fatigue is a collection of symptoms that can occur when your level of stress – whether it is physical, emotional, mental, or a combination – overwhelms your body's ability to compensate for that stress. Stress can essentially strip all of the nutrients away from where it's needed, like building important regulatory hormones. Our Adrenal hormones are needed in order to regulate our complicated day to day processes, staying focused, and sleep properly. Blackstone Labs set out to support these Adrenal hormones with its proprietary, cutting-edge formula, Adrenal Care. Blackstone Labs specifically designed Adrenal Care to promote sound HPA axis gland structure and adrenal fatigue recovery.It contains important compounds that are required in adrenal hormone synthesis and energy production†It's formulated with optimal bioavailability of its active constituents †Adrenal Care has unique nutrient amounts for effective support during stress and adrenal fatigue†It's Synergistic combination enhances efficacy of individual nutrients†Its unique protein-based building blocks for sound HPA axis gland structure are able to sustain healthy functions†Supports brain health and cognitive health†Adrenal Care by Blackstone Labs is the foremost Adrenal support product available today. Adrenal Care supports the building of these regulating hormones with the raw materials it needs and gives you that extra balance you need to stay feeling great. Adrenal glandulars are adrenal supplements made up of actual adrenal gland tissue. Adrenal Care provides the support your adrenals need to repair themselves and return to normal function. Adrenal Care should be your first choice of adrenal support supplements for mild to moderate cases of adrenal fatigue. Zinc (30mg):One of the 24 micronutrients needed for survival, zinc benefits everything from testosterone to immune function.Inositol Hexanicotinate (750mg):Inositol hexanicotinate (INH), often marketed as "no flush" niacin, allows you to derive the substantial metabolic benefits of niacin (vit. B3) without the uncomfortable flushing sensation that often accompanies supplemental niacin.DMAE (750mg):DMAE (dimethylaminoethanol) can readily cross the blood brain barrier where it then acts as both a protective compound and helps the body synthesize its primary neurotransmitter, acetylcholine. DMAE supplementation has shown a variety of therapeutic benefits for cognitive disorders like attention-deficit hyperactivity disorder and memory lapses.Bovine Adrenal Gland Extract (500mg):Glandular extracts come from the hormone-producing glands of animals and are beneficial for individuals not getting adequate daily nutrients—particularly those that support the adrenal and thyroid glands. Glandular extracts often have a tonic effect on the body by correcting deficiencies of limiting adrenal nutrients required for the synthesis of protective or energetic hormones.Magnesium Glycinate (300mg):Magnesium is the second most prevalent electrolyte in the human body, an essential dietary mineral, and (perhaps most importantly) the most commonly deficient mineral in the standard American diet. In the context of the adrenals, magnesium helps the body, from its muscles down to its literal cells, relax. Relaxed cells are able to then achieve a high-energy state associated with rest and repair. Overstimulated cells are calcium dominant, and the magnesium displaces the calcium. In states of adrenal fatigue, cells are chronically overstimulated and thus exhausted. Magnesium counteracts this overexcited state. This particular form of magnesium, glycinate, is readily absorbed from the intestine and less likely to produce gastrointestinal side-effects like diarrhea and bloating.Glycyrrhetinic Acid (Licorice Extract) (200mg):Glycyrrhetinic Acid inhibits both 11β-hydroxysteroid dehydrogenase enzymes (Type 1 and Type 2, the enzymes that control cortisol levels), with slightly more effect on the Type I (Anti-cortisol) than Type II (Pro-cortisol). Therefore, the net effect is a reduction in serum cortisol (a stress hormone that is chronically elevated in those with adrenal fatigue). The decrease in cortisol increase has been noted to be 39-50% after 3-500mg glycyrrhetinic acid (the active ingredient in Adrenal Care)—which is substantial. In other words, the glycyrrhetinic acid in Adrenal Care can potentially cut your stress levels (as measured by cortisol) in half.Korean Ginseng (1% eleutherosides) (100mg):An herb used in traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) for thousands of years, eleutherococcus reduces lethargy and fatigue, improves stamina and endurance, and boosts resilience to environmental stressors.Huperzine A (Huperzia Serrata) (moss) (300mcg):Huperzine A's most recognized and desired action is inhibiting the acetylcholinesterase enzyme. This effect, coupled with co-ingestion of a choline donor like the DMAE in Adrenal Care, prolongs and magnifies the benefits. In addition to positive effects on mood and muscle contraction, huperzine A can even improve learning. As a dietary supplement, take two (2) Tablets twice daily. Do not exceed four (4) tablets daily. Finish entire contents of bottle over a thirty (30) day period.

title: Cheat Pill
description: The Cheat Pill provides fat and calorie control while further reducing cravings. This unique blend of ingredients helps to inhibit enzymes responsible for carbohydrate and fat digestion, limiting the amount of calories absorbed into your system. The Cheat Pill is perfect for special occasions such as vacations and holidays, or for individuals who know they will be straying from their diet.* ACTIVE INGREDIENTS Stimulant-Free Fat Blocker – The Cheat Pill helps block the absorption of fats using two different mechanisms. The herb Cassia nomame blocks the enzyme lipase from breaking down fats into absorbable subunits, whereas Chitosan is a fiber that helps move the undigested fats by binding to them and pushing them through the intestinal tract and preventing absorption.* Appetite Suppressing Formula – The Cheat Pill also reduces appetite and cravings for high fat and high carb foods. Glucomannan is a highly filling fiber that can absorb up to 200 times its weight in water, swelling up dramatically and occupying space in the gut, helping you feel fuller faster and for longer. The natural South African appetite suppressant Hoodia gordonii provides added protection.* Advanced Carb Blocker – Similar to the fat blocker, the carb blocker helps prevent the breakdown and absorption of both simple and complex carbohydrates. White Kidney Bean Extract has demonstrated it inhibits the enzyme alpha-amylase. This enzyme helps break down complex starchy carbohydrates into simple sugars that can be absorbed. The combination of chromium and Gymnema sylvestre control the absorption of simple sugars and stabilize the hormone insulin to provide a full spectrum carbohydrate-blocking tandem.* SUGGESTED USE Take 2 capsules at least 30 minutes prior to your meal with at least 16 oz. of water.

The Science Behind Creatine Creatine is a naturally occurring compound found in muscle cells. It helps regenerate adenosine triphosphate (ATP), the primary energy source used during high-intensity and explosive movements like weightlifting, sprinting, and interval training. During intense exercise, ATP is rapidly depleted. Supplementing with creatine helps replenish ATP levels more efficiently, allowing muscles to perform at higher intensities for longer periods. Creatine is one of the most studied sports nutrition ingredients and is suitable for beginners, experienced lifters, and recreational exercisers alike. Can women take creatine gummies?Yes. While supplements cannot replace hard training and proper nutrition, several components in this stack are grounded in scientific research: • D-Aspartic Acid (D-AA):D-Aspartic Acid is an amino acid involved in hormone signaling pathways and has been studied for its potential to influence testosterone production. Some early research showed short-term increases in circulating testosterone in certain populations, particularly in men with lower baseline levels, but results are mixed in resistance-trained individuals—with several controlled trials showing no significant benefit on testosterone, strength, or muscle mass in trained lifters. • Herbal Hormone Support (Maca Root, Fenugreek, Saw Palmetto):Botanicals like maca root and fenugreek are traditionally used for overall energy and hormonal support. While maca may help with general well-being and stamina, evidence for a direct boost in testosterone is limited and inconclusive. Fenugreek appears safe and may aid metabolic and hormonal balance, but definitive clinical data for muscle-building claims are still emerging. Saw palmetto, commonly included for prostate health, has limited evidence supporting hormonal or performance benefits. Ecdysterone (20-Hydroxyecdysone) Ecdysterone is a naturally occurring phytoecdysteroid found in plants such as quinoa and spinach. It belongs to a class of compounds originally identified as insect molting hormones but now studied for potential anabolic effects in mammals. Mechanism: Ecdysterone appears to enhance muscle protein synthesis through intracellular signaling pathways like PI3K/Akt and may interact with estrogen receptor beta (ERβ), which can support muscle growth without binding to androgen receptors like testosterone does. Turkesterone Turkesterone is another phytoecdysteroid most often derived from the plant Ajuga turkestanica. Like ecdysterone, it is a plant-based steroid-like compound that does not bind to androgen receptors, making it non-hormonal. Mechanism: Turkesterone may support workouts by enhancing protein synthesis and metabolic pathways similar to ecdysterone, potentially influencing recovery and tissue repair. Massularia acuminata Extract — Backed by Science Massularia acuminata is a plant traditionally used in West Africa to support male vitality and performance. Modern research has begun to explore how this extract may support muscle-building and testosterone-related pathways. Preclinical studies show that Massularia acuminata extract may help support healthy testosterone levels, along with related hormones involved in strength, energy, and recovery. In animal research, supplementation was associated with increases in testosterone and improvements in protein activity within muscle-related tissues—key factors tied to muscle growth and physical performance. Unlike synthetic hormones, Massularia acuminata works by supporting the body’s natural hormonal signaling, making it a popular ingredient in performance-focused formulas designed to complement intense training and proper nutrition. While human clinical research is still emerging, its long history of traditional use combined with promising scientific findings makes Massularia acuminata a compelling ingredient for those looking to support strength, muscle development, and overall male performance. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ (5/5) “Solid stack for strength-focused training”I’ve been lifting consistently for years and wanted something simple to support my training. title: 1 oz. Steel Smokehouse Brisket Beef Jerky
description: Introducing a culinary first for Steel: Smokehouse Brisket Beef Jerky. Sourced from the highest quality meats, our Brisket Beef Jerky is tender, packed with flavor, and perfectly chewable. Each bag is crafted with natural ingredients that do not compromise on flavor, providing you with a clean way to enjoy your favorite treat. Korean BBQ: An in-house favorite, Korean BBQ is a great fit for tender brisket. Gluten-free tamari, a bit of sweetness, garlic & onion, finished with a blend of mouth-watering spices makes for a truly unique flavor. If you are looking for something new, we highly recommend this flavor.Cracked Pepper: A classic flavor leaning heavily into the rustic, traditional flavor of Cracked Pepper straight from the mill. Beef jerky traditionalists will appreciate the simple, powerful taste. It’s the classic, done right.Teriyaki: A classic flavor, providing the ideal balance between soy sauce, light pineapple, and Worcestershire. Pops of savory garlic, tamarind, and clove help to elevate the flavor to a new level with a small but noticeable twist on traditional Teriyaki. Spicy Sweet: Spicy Sweet brings a novel approach to how brisket beef jerky is typically seasoned, hitting you with equal notes of heat and sweetness. Fans of Kansas City-style barbecue sauce will know what to expect, and the seasoning compliments the tenderness of our brisket just right. Smoky BBQ: A mesquite style barbecue approach with hits of rustic tomato, gluten-free tamari, onion, garlic, and a delicious blend of peppers. Smoky BBQ has a heavy, straightforward taste you can savor. Carne Asada: If it ain’t broke, don’t fix it. Carne Asada plays it tried and true by incorporating orange juice, lime juice, garlic, jalapeños, and other spices in order to bring you a full-flavored experience while keeping the meat perfectly tender.Tropical Fusion: It’s like a vacation in a bag that also has Beef Jerky in it (win-win). Infused with tropical flavors like mango and pineapple, this Beef Jerky has a forward sweetness that is rounded out with classic grilling flavors like garlic, onion and Worcestershire.Salt N Pepper Honey: A classic salt and pepper profile with a sweet twist. Salt N Pepper Honey is generously seasoned and infused with honey, accompanied by other classic Beef Jerky flavors like onion, garlic, ginger, and clove. If you are looking for a modern take on an all-time favorite, Salt N Pepper Honey has you covered. Salt N Pepper Honey, Tropical Fusion, Teriyaki, Korean BBQ & Spicy Sweet are not gluten-free. Smoky BBQ, Cracked Pepper, Buffalo Chicken, Carne Asada & Honey BBQ are gluten-free. Steel Supplements products are manufactured in a facility that handles all common food allergens. Machine sanitation protocols are performed as required, however, cross-contamination is still possible.

Suggested use - How do I take 1 Andro? Take 1 tablet of 1-Andro in the morning on an empty stomach. Ideally, you do not want to eat for 30-60 minutes, but 30 minutes is sufficient. 10-12 hours later, take 1 tablet of 1-Andro on an empty stomach. If you are using multiple Andros, simply follow the twice per day dosing schedule, and take your Andros together. How do I take multiple Andros at the same time? Ideally, you do not want to consume food for the following 30-60 minutes. 10-12 hours later, take 1 tablet of each Andro without food, ideally waiting 30-60 minutes before consuming food. If you run Andros for 4 weeks, take 4 weeks off (Alpha-AF PCT can be used for the 4 weeks off). If you run Andros for 8 weeks, take 8 weeks off (4 week cycle of Alpha-AF + additional 4 week break off all T modulators). title: 2.5 oz. Steel Smokehouse Brisket Beef Jerky
description: Introducing a culinary first for Steel: Smokehouse Brisket Beef Jerky. Sourced from the highest quality meats, our Brisket Beef Jerky is tender, packed with flavor, and perfectly chewable. Each bag is crafted with natural ingredients that do not compromise on flavor, providing you with a clean way to enjoy your favorite treat. Korean BBQ: An in-house favorite, Korean BBQ is a great fit for tender brisket. Gluten-free tamari, a bit of sweetness, garlic & onion, finished with a blend of mouth-watering spices makes for a truly unique flavor. If you are looking for something new, we highly recommend this flavor.Cracked Pepper: A classic flavor leaning heavily into the rustic, traditional flavor of Cracked Pepper straight from the mill. Beef jerky traditionalists will appreciate the simple, powerful taste. It’s the classic, done right.Teriyaki: A classic flavor, providing the ideal balance between soy sauce, light pineapple, and Worcestershire. Pops of savory garlic, tamarind, and clove help to elevate the flavor to a new level with a small but noticeable twist on traditional Teriyaki. Spicy Sweet: Spicy Sweet brings a novel approach to how brisket beef jerky is typically seasoned, hitting you with equal notes of heat and sweetness. Fans of Kansas City-style barbecue sauce will know what to expect, and the seasoning compliments the tenderness of our brisket just right. Smoky BBQ: A mesquite style barbecue approach with hits of rustic tomato, gluten-free tamari, onion, garlic, and a delicious blend of peppers. Smoky BBQ has a heavy, straightforward taste you can savor. Carne Asada: If it ain’t broke, don’t fix it. Carne Asada plays it tried and true by incorporating orange juice, lime juice, garlic, jalapeños, and other spices in order to bring you a full-flavored experience while keeping the meat perfectly tender.Tropical Fusion: It’s like a vacation in a bag that also has Beef Jerky in it (win-win). Infused with tropical flavors like mango and pineapple, this Beef Jerky has a forward sweetness that is rounded out with classic grilling flavors like garlic, onion and Worcestershire.Salt N Pepper Honey: A classic salt and pepper profile with a sweet twist. Salt N Pepper Honey is generously seasoned and infused with honey, accompanied by other classic Beef Jerky flavors like onion, garlic, ginger, and clove. If you are looking for a modern take on an all-time favorite, Salt N Pepper Honey has you covered. Salt N Pepper Honey, Tropical Fusion, Teriyaki, Korean BBQ & Spicy Sweet are not gluten-free. Smoky BBQ, Cracked Pepper, Buffalo Chicken, Carne Asada & Honey BBQ are gluten-free. Steel Supplements products are manufactured in a facility that handles all common food allergens. Machine sanitation protocols are performed as required, however, cross-contamination is still possible.

Ideally, you do not want to consume food for the following 30-60 minutes. 10-12 hours later, take 1 tablet of each Andro without food, ideally waiting 30-60 minutes before consuming food. Repeat this for the length of the cycle. Does 4-ANDRO require liver support or on cycle therapy? Neither liver support nor on-cycle therapy is required, however, you will need to utilize Alpha-AF for PCT purposes, once you have finished your Andro cycle. In short, what is the difference between all of the Andros products? 1-Andro - Lean Hard Gains 4-Andro - Muscle and Strength Gains 17a-Andro - Strength and Muscle Composition 19-Nor-Andro - Power and Competitive Drive 3-EPI-Andro - Fat Mobilization and Water Depletion 7,3-Andro - Fat Mobilization and Cortisol Management What are the side effects of 4-ANDRO? The side effects range greatly from person to person. Genetics, lifestyle, eating habits and other variables all contribute to the side effects or lack of side effects users experience. For most, Alpha is perfect for restoring the hormonal balance of the body and ensuring the user keeps the majority of their new muscle gains. What is good to stack with 4-ANDRO? To maximize results, we suggest using Rested-AF for higher sleep quality, muscle recovery, and cognitive function day-to-day. We also suggest products such as ADAbolic and ADA-Load for optimized nutrient partitioning, muscle hydration, and caloric efficiency. Does it matter if I take them with food? You have slightly better absorption of the Andros on an empty stomach, but they still are effective even when taken with a small meal. How old must I be to take 4-ANDRO? You must be atleast 18 years old. However, we do advise people under the age of 21 to stick to effective mass builders such as Pumped and ADABOLIC. Can women take 4-ANDRO? No. How long do I have to come off of the 4-ANDRO before getting back on? We operate under a time-on/time-off policy. If you run Andros for 4 weeks, take 4 weeks off (Alpha-AF PCT can be used for the 4 weeks off). If you run Andros for 8 weeks, take 8 weeks off (4 week cycle of Alpha-AF + additional 4 week break off all T modulators). Can 4-ANDRO be taken with other Steel products like Shredded? 4-ANDRO can be taken with ALL Steel products. We suggest waiting to take Alpha-AF until after you have completed your Andro cycle for PCT purposes. Can I drink alcohol on 4-ANDRO? We do not advise drinking alcohol on Andros, mainly because when we consume alcohol we suppress testosterone and the conversion of the Andros into testosterone. Refer to Dr. Paul Henning's article that takes a deep dive into athletic performance and alcohol What do I do if I forget to take a dose? Do not double up, just take 4-ANDRO when you can, and get back to your initial regimen. How long can I cycle 4-ANDRO for? You can choose between a 4 week cycle, or an 8 week cycle. Regardless of which cycle you decide, ensure that you run Alpha-AF for PCT purposes afterwards. 8 week cycles generally only require 1 bottle of Alpha-AF for PCT What products can be paired with Andros? Andros can be taken alongside PRE, Charged, Amped, Adabolic, Hyperade, Pumped, NO7, ATP-Fusion, Rested, BCAAS, ADA-Load Protein(Veg, Whey, Whey ISOI) 4-DHEA Other Ingredients: Microcrystalline Cellulose, Phosphatidycholine, Hydroxpropyl-beta-cyclodextrin (HPBCD), Phytosterol, Stearic Acid, Magnesium Stearate, Starch, Titanium Dioxide, Silica, Black Color

title: 7 oz. Steel Smokehouse Brisket Beef Jerky

Sourced from the highest quality meats, our Brisket Beef Jerky is tender, packed with flavor, and perfectly chewable. title: 7, 3-Andro
description: For best results, 7,3-ANDRO should be used as part of a structured Andro cycle and followed with proper post-cycle support. Choose your stack based on your goal, experience level, and training phase. For Andro stacks: click here For Alpha-AF (PCT): click here For Andro Guide: click here 7,3-ANDRO is Steel’s recomp, cutting, and hardening-focused Andro, built for experienced lifters who want definition, density, lean performance, and a sharper physique during disciplined cutting or recomposition phases. Powered by a multi-active formula featuring 100 mg of 3-hydroxy-androstane-17-one, 25 mg of 7a-hydroxy-dehydroepiandrosterone, and 50 mg of 6-keto diosgenin per tablet, 7,3-ANDRO delivers 200 mg, 50 mg, and 100 mg of these actives daily when used as directed. This is not a watery mass product. 7,3-ANDRO is built for the leaner, tighter, more defined side of the Steel Andro system. Where 1-ANDRO is the lean-mass foundation, 4-ANDRO supports fullness and drive, and 3-EPI-ANDRO sharpens the dry hardening lane, 7,3-ANDRO is built for users chasing recomposition, cutting support, definition, and a harder look while keeping performance in focus. Built To Support Recomposition-focused cycles Cutting and definition phases Muscle hardness and density Lean performance A tighter, sharper physique Fat-loss support when paired with proper diet and training Advanced hardening stacks Experienced lifters chasing a leaner, more defined look Formula Snapshot Active Ingredient: 3-hydroxy-androstane-17-oneAmount Per Tablet: 100 mgDaily Active Amount When Used As Directed: 200 mgSecondary Active: 7a-hydroxy-dehydroepiandrosteroneAmount Per Tablet: 25 mgDaily Active Amount When Used As Directed: 50 mgAdditional Active: 6-keto diosgeninAmount Per Tablet: 50 mgDaily Active Amount When Used As Directed: 100 mgRecommended Daily Use: 2 tablets dailyBottle Count: 60 tabletsCycle Supply: 30 days when used as directedFormula Type: Non-methylated Andro supportPrimary Lane: Recomp, cutting, hardening, definition, and estrogen-conscious cycle supportBest For: Lifters chasing a leaner, harder, more defined physique while keeping strength and performance in focus What Makes 7,3-ANDRO Different? 7,3-ANDRO is built for users who want more than size alone. Its role in the Steel lineup is to support the cutting, recomp, and definition side of a structured Andro cycle. This is the Andro you reach for when the goal is to tighten up, look harder, support lean performance, and bring out a sharper physique. Where 4-ANDRO is built more for fullness and drive, and 19-NOR-ANDRO is built more for strength, mass, recovery, and joint-comfort support, 7,3-ANDRO is built for the leaner visual outcome: definition, hardness, body-composition support, and a more dialed-in look. Who 7,3-ANDRO Is For 7,3-ANDRO is designed for experienced lifters who understand structured cycle-based supplementation and want a more serious option for cutting, recomposition, and hardening-focused phases. It is best suited for users focused on definition, density, lean performance, and a tighter look.If your goal is maximum fullness, size, and heavy mass-focused training, 4-ANDRO or 19-NOR-ANDRO may be a better primary fit. If your goal is to look leaner, harder, tighter, and more defined, 7,3-ANDRO belongs in the center of the conversation. Liposomal Delivery Technology Every Steel Andro is built with liposomal delivery technology to help support absorption and ingredient uptake. By pairing active Andro compounds with lipid-based carriers, this delivery system is designed to improve efficiency compared to standard oral formulas. For 7,3-ANDRO, that means each tablet delivers a multi-active Andro formula in a format built for serious users who care about consistency, precision, and performance-focused formulation. Suggested 7,3-ANDRO Stacks Recomp / Cutting Stack 7,3-ANDRO + 1-ANDRO Best for users focused on recomposition, definition, cutting support, and lean performance. Why this stack works:1-ANDRO supports lean mass and strength. 7,3-ANDRO supports the cutting, recomp, and definition side of the cycle. This is a strong stack for users trying to hold strength and muscle while tightening up. Best For: Recomposition Cutting support Lean mass retention Definition Harder look Strength while leaning out Dry Hardening Stack 7,3-ANDRO + 3-EPI-ANDRO Best for users focused on hardening, definition, recomp, vascularity, and a drier physique. Why this stack works:7,3-ANDRO supports the recomp and cutting-support lane. 3-EPI-ANDRO adds dry hardening, density, vascularity, and the sharper cosmetic edge. Together, this is one of the strongest dry-focused pairings in the Steel Andro lineup. Best For: Cutting support Recomposition Muscle hardness Definition Vascularity Lean, dry physique support Advanced Hardening / Recomp Stack 7,3-ANDRO + 1-ANDRO + 3-EPI-ANDRO Best for advanced users chasing a serious dry, hard, lean, recomp-focused cycle. Why this stack works:1-ANDRO is the lean-mass and strength foundation. 7,3-ANDRO supports recomp, cutting support, and definition. 3-EPI-ANDRO adds hardening, density, and the dry cosmetic edge. Together, this stack is built for experienced users who want strength, hardness, definition, and a leaner look in one advanced cycle. Best For: Advanced recomposition Dry hardening Definition Vascularity Strength retention Dense, lean physique support Ripped Stack 7,3-ANDRO + 3-EPI-ANDRO + 17a-ANDRO Best for experienced users chasing a dry, hard, defined look with added stack depth and support during a cutting or recomp phase. Why this stack works:7,3-ANDRO supports recomp, definition, and cutting support. 3-EPI-ANDRO supports the hardening and density lane. 17a-ANDRO adds advanced stack support for users looking to keep strength, fullness, and performance moving during a more aggressive physique-focused phase. Best For: Cutting phases Recomp phases Hardness and definition Strength support Fullness support while leaning out Experienced users wanting a deeper stack Beach Body Stack 7,3-ANDRO + 1-ANDRO + 3-EPI-ANDRO + ADABOLIC Best for users chasing definition, hardness, lean mass retention, training performance, and recovery support during a cutting or recomp phase. Why this stack works:1-ANDRO supports lean mass and strength. 7,3-ANDRO supports recomp, cutting support, and definition. 3-EPI-ANDRO supports hardness, density, and the dry cosmetic edge. ADABOLIC can be added for users looking to support training output, hydration, pumps, and recovery during demanding training blocks. Best For: Beach body phases Cutting support Recomposition Training output Pump and hydration support Lean, hard physique goals Ultimate Shred Stack 7,3-ANDRO + 3-EPI-ANDRO + SHREDDED-AF Best for experienced users focused on a disciplined cutting phase where the goal is definition, hardness, energy support, and a leaner look. Why this stack works:7,3-ANDRO and 3-EPI-ANDRO form a dry cutting and hardening-focused Andro base. SHREDDED-AF can be added for users seeking additional fat-loss support during a true caloric deficit. Best For: Cutting phases Definition Hardness Energy support Fat-loss support Experienced users managing diet and stimulant intake responsibly Choosing The Right 7,3-ANDRO Stack For recomp and cutting support:7,3-ANDRO + 1-ANDROFor dry hardening and definition:7,3-ANDRO + 3-EPI-ANDROFor advanced hardening and recomp:7,3-ANDRO + 1-ANDRO + 3-EPI-ANDROFor a ripped, defined look with added stack support:7,3-ANDRO + 3-EPI-ANDRO + 17a-ANDROFor beach-body style cutting support:7,3-ANDRO + 1-ANDRO + 3-EPI-ANDRO + ADABOLICFor ultimate shred support:7,3-ANDRO + 3-EPI-ANDRO + SHREDDED-AFFor full stack planning, view the complete Steel Andro Guide. Alpha-AF Post-Cycle Support Because 7,3-ANDRO is designed for structured cycle-based use, Steel recommends following your cycle with proper post-cycle support. Alpha-AF is Steel’s PCT and natural testosterone support formula, built with key minerals, hormone-support ingredients, and absorption support to help users transition after an Andro cycle.For best results, use 7,3-ANDRO as part of a structured Andro cycle and follow with Alpha-AF as post-cycle support. Can Alpha-AF Be Used During A Cycle? Alpha-AF may also be used by experienced users seeking additional hormone-support and mineral support during or after a cycle, but it is most commonly positioned as the post-cycle support product in the Steel system.If you are building a full Andro cycle, Alpha-AF should be considered part of the complete plan, not an afterthought. Cycle Length Guidance Steel Andros are designed for structured cycle-based use, not indefinite daily use. Most users structure Andro cycles around defined 4-week or 8-week phases, followed by post-cycle support and time off.A 4-week cycle is the more conservative approach and may be better suited for users who are newer to structured cycle planning or using an Andro for the first time.An 8-week cycle should be reserved for experienced users who understand their tolerance, training, nutrition, hydration, recovery, and post-cycle support needs. Larger multi-product stacks should be approached conservatively before extending cycle length.Do not run Andros continuously. Do not exceed label directions. Do not combine with alcohol, recreational drugs, or unnecessary stressors that can work against recovery, hydration, liver health, hormone balance, sleep, and training performance.After completing a cycle, use ALPHA as post-cycle support and allow time off before beginning another Andro cycle. More is not always better. Choose cycle length based on experience level, goal, tolerance, training phase, and ability to recover properly. Optional Performance Support ADABOLIC:ADABOLIC can be used alongside structured Andro cycles by users looking to support training output, pumps, recovery, hydration, and performance during demanding training blocks.Best paired with:Cutting, recomp, hardening, and strength-focused Andro stacks where training performance, pump, hydration, and recovery support are priorities. N.O.7:N.O.7 can be used as a non-stimulant pre-workout support product during hardening, cutting, and beach-body focused stacks. It is best positioned for users looking to support pumps and training performance without adding stimulant load.Best paired with:Beach-body, cutting, and recomp stacks where pump and training output are important. SHREDDED-AF:SHREDDED-AF is best suited for users in a disciplined cutting phase who want additional fat-loss and energy support. It should be used responsibly and should not be stacked with unnecessary stimulant load.Best paired with:Cutting and shred-focused stacks where the user is already controlling calories, training consistently, and managing stimulant intake. HYPERBOLIC:HYPERBOLIC is best suited for users in a calorie-supported growth phase. Because 7,3-ANDRO is primarily a recomp, cutting, and hardening-focused Andro, HYPERBOLIC is not the primary support product for this page, but it may be useful for users trying to maintain calories and recovery during a lean-mass or recomp phase.Best paired with:Lean-mass or recomp cycles where the user needs additional calorie and nutrition support. Cycle Summary Guidelines Steel Andros are built for structured, goal-specific cycles. To get the most out of your cycle, support the process with disciplined training, nutrition, hydration, sleep, and post-cycle support. During use, we recommend avoiding alcohol and unnecessary stressors that can work against recovery, hydration, sleep quality, liver health, hormone balance, and training performance. Users should not exceed the recommended daily use and should avoid combining multiple hormone-pathway products unless they are experienced and understand structured cycle-based supplementation. For best results, pair your Andro cycle with consistent protein intake, goal-appropriate calories, progressive training, adequate rest, and proper post-cycle support with Alpha-AF. Nutrition Recommendations For cutting or recomposition:Use a controlled calorie deficit or maintenance intake, keep protein high, and avoid crash dieting. The goal is to support performance while leaning out, not destroy recovery.For hardening-focused phases:Keep nutrition clean, protein consistent, hydration high, and carbohydrates placed strategically around training. A dry, hard look is built through training, diet, consistency, and the right stack structure.For lean mass retention:Do not crash calories too aggressively. 7,3-ANDRO is best used in a disciplined plan where the goal is to look leaner and more defined while keeping training performance intact. Training Recommendations Train with structure.Progressive overload, smart exercise selection, controlled volume, and recovery days matter more than just adding more products.Do not confuse cutting support with unlimited recovery.Harder training still requires recovery, hydration, sleep, and smart programming.Match the stack to the training phase.Use 7,3-ANDRO in cutting, recomp, hardening, and physique-focused phases where definition, density, and performance matter. Lifestyle Recommendations For best results during an Andro cycle: Avoid alcohol during use Do not exceed recommended daily use Stay hydrated Maintain electrolyte intake Prioritize sleep Keep protein intake consistent Avoid crash dieting Avoid unnecessary stimulant abuse Avoid recreational drugs Avoid stacking with other hormone-pathway products unless experienced Follow the cycle with Alpha-AF post-cycle support Advanced Stack Notice More is not always better. Advanced stacks are intended for experienced users only. If you are new to Andros, start with a simpler cycle before combining multiple products.Users should choose a stack based on their goal, experience level, training status, and tolerance. Do not exceed recommended use. Important Use Notice Not for use by individuals under 18. Do not use if pregnant, nursing, or trying to become pregnant. Consult a qualified healthcare professional before use if you have or have had liver, kidney, cardiovascular, blood pressure, endocrine, prostate, cholesterol, or other medical concerns, or if you take prescription medications. Discontinue use and consult a healthcare professional if you experience adverse reactions. Important Cycle Note For maximum results, this product is designed to be used as part of a structured Andro cycle and followed with proper post-cycle support. Individual results may vary based on training, nutrition, consistency, experience level, and overall cycle structure.Steel Andros are not casual daily wellness products. They are advanced performance supplements for experienced users who respect the process: train hard, eat with purpose, recover intelligently, avoid alcohol during use, and follow the cycle with proper post-cycle support. How do I take 7,3-Andro? Take 1 tablet in the morning on an empty stomach and a second tablet 10–12 hours later. For optimal absorption, wait approximately 30 minutes before eating after each serving. Continue daily, including rest days, throughout your cycle. Can I take multiple Andros together? Yes. Multiple Andros can be taken together by following the same twice-daily schedule. Take one serving of each product in the morning and again 10–12 hours later. Do I need liver support or on-cycle therapy? No additional liver support or on-cycle therapy is required. Post-cycle support is recommended after completing your cycle. What is 7,3-Andro designed to support? 7,3-Andro is commonly used as part of physique-focused training programs and is often selected by athletes seeking support for body composition and training goals. What can I stack with 7,3-Andro? 7,3-Andro can be used alongside a variety of performance, recovery, hydration, and nutrition supplements depending on your training objectives. Should I take it with food? For maximum absorption, it is best taken on an empty stomach. However, it may still be used effectively if taken with a light meal. How old do I need to be to use 7,3-Andro? 7,3-Andro is intended for healthy adults 18 years of age or older. Can women use 7,3-Andro? No. Due to the hormone-support nature of this product, it is not intended for women. How long should I wait before starting another cycle? A time-on/time-off approach is generally recommended. After completing a cycle, allow an appropriate recovery period before beginning another cycle. Can I use 7,3-Andro with other STEEL supplements? Yes. 7,3-Andro can be incorporated into a broader supplement program and may be used alongside compatible performance and recovery products. Can I drink alcohol while using 7,3-Andro? Alcohol consumption is not recommended during a cycle, as it may negatively affect recovery, training performance, and overall results. What should I do if I miss a dose? If you miss a serving, do not double your next dose. Simply continue with your normal schedule at the next planned serving. How long can I cycle 7,3-Andro? Most users choose either a 4-week or 8-week cycle. That matters because heavy lifting, sprinting, explosive movement, and repeated hard sets all require rapid energy turnover. ATP-FUSION uses creatine monohydrate because it is simple, proven, and effective. There is no need to chase trendy forms when the foundation still works. Creatine is not a stimulant. This is why ATP-FUSION is built as a daily performance staple. The brain also uses large amounts of energy, and creatine plays a role in brain energy metabolism. Research has explored creatine for cognitive performance, memory, mental fatigue, sleep-stress resilience, and aging-related support. The evidence is strongest for physical performance, but the brain and healthy-aging research is one of the most exciting areas around creatine. Creatine is not just a bodybuilding ingredient. It is a cellular energy ingredient. Why Sodium + Potassium? ATP-FUSION includes sodium and potassium because creatine does not exist in a vacuum. Sodium and potassium are key electrolytes involved in fluid balance, muscle contraction, nerve signaling, cellular hydration, and performance. Adding sodium and potassium gives ATP-FUSION a more performance-focused structure than plain creatine alone. ATP-FUSION is built for users who want creatine support without turning their creatine into a sugar bomb. No Loading Phase Required ATP-FUSION does not require a loading phase. The smarter move for most users is simple: take it daily, train consistently, hydrate properly, and let saturation build. No loading phase. No complicated timing. No unnecessary protocol. This also makes ATP-FUSION easy to stack with stimulant-based pre-workouts, nootropic formulas, nitric oxide products, protein powders, recovery products, body-composition support products, and structured performance cycles. It supports performance without pushing the nervous system. Key Ingredient Support Creatine Monohydrate Creatine monohydrate supports ATP regeneration, strength, power output, lean muscle support, high-intensity training performance, recovery, cognitive performance, and brain energy support. In ATP-FUSION, creatine monohydrate is the foundation. How To Use ATP-FUSION Use ATP-FUSION as directed on the label. ATP-FUSION can be used any time of day, including before training, after training, with a meal, or on rest days. N.O.7 brings the blood-flow and pump lane, supporting nitric oxide, vasodilation, vascular performance, nutrient flow, endurance, and the full, vein-popping look that makes this stack feel different in the gym. Together, these five products create a more complete beach-body system than any single product can provide alone: lean mass from 1-ANDRO, dryness and hardness from 3-EPI-ANDRO, recomp and definition support from 7,3-ANDRO, training-window support from ADABOLIC, and pump/vascularity support from N.O.7. Who This Stack Is For The Beach Bod Stack is designed for experienced users who want more than a basic fat-loss product or a basic Andro cycle. It is built for people chasing a leaner, harder, fuller, more defined physique while still prioritizing performance in the gym. This stack is best for users focused on: Lean size Recomposition Muscle hardness Definition Vascularity Pumps Training endurance Strength while leaning out A fuller, tighter, beach-ready look Performance-focused physique transformation If you are new to Andros, start with a simpler cycle first. Best training styles include: Hypertrophy training Strength-focused lifting High-volume bodybuilding Recomp-focused training blocks Conditioning work paired with resistance training Athletic performance training Lift weights. A beach-body look is built by preserving and building muscle while body fat comes down. Cardio can help increase calorie expenditure, but resistance training should remain the foundation if the goal is a lean, hard, muscular look. Train hard, but train intelligently. ADABOLIC and N.O.7 can help support pumps, endurance, hydration, and training output, but recovery still matters. Pump + Performance Guidance This stack has a serious pump and performance lane because it includes both ADABOLIC and N.O.7. ADABOLIC supports training fuel, hydration, amino acid availability, endurance, creatine intake, betaine support, citrulline-driven pumps, electrolytes, and recovery. N.O.7 is designed to support nitric oxide, vasodilation, blood flow, nutrient flow, cell volumization, and endurance. Its formula includes epicatechin compounds, making it a strong non-stimulant pump partner inside this stack. Together, ADABOLIC and N.O.7 help give the Beach Bod Stack its full, vascular, skin-tight training feel. This is not just a visual stack. It is built to help you train like the physique matters. Steel recommends following Andro cycles with ALPHA, Steel’s natural testosterone support and post-cycle support formula. ALPHA is designed to support natural testosterone production, healthy estrogen balance, drive, performance, and the transition after advanced Andro use. Do not treat post-cycle support as an afterthought. If you are planning the stack, plan the recovery phase too. Most users structure Andro cycles around defined 4-week or 8-week phases, followed by post-cycle support and time off. A 4-week cycle is the more conservative approach and may be better suited for users who are newer to structured cycle planning or using a stack for the first time. An 8-week cycle should be reserved for experienced users who understand their tolerance, training, nutrition, hydration, recovery, and post-cycle support needs. After completing a cycle, use ALPHA as post-cycle support and allow time off before beginning another Andro cycle. More is not always better. Choose cycle length based on experience level, goal, tolerance, training phase, and ability to recover properly. Run it with structure. Eat with discipline. Train with intent. Hydrate like it matters. Chase the pump. Recover properly. Follow with ALPHA. For the N.O.7 and ADAbolic: take one capsule of N.O.7 20-30 minutes prior to training, and dose your ADAbolic based on the recommendation below. How to take ADAbolic depends on your weight and goals. For max muscle gains take it pre-, intra-, and post-workout. For fat loss take it immediately post-workout. If you are looking to add muscle while leaning out, take it intra-workout and immediately post-workout. 100lbs–150lbs: 1–1.5 scoops per training day 150lbs–200lbs: 1–2 scoops per training day 200lbs–250lbs: 1–2.5 scoops per training day 250lbs+: 1–3 scoops per training day Can I drink alcohol on this stack? We do not advise drinking alcohol on Andros, mainly because alcohol suppresses testosterone levels and the conversion of Andros into testosterone. Alcohol also taxes the liver, causing your body to prioritize liver recovery instead of muscle repair and growth. Can women take this stack? No. Due to the hormonally modulating nature of Andros, this stack may lead to adverse effects in women, including virilization and hormonal imbalances. Can I take ALPHA-AF during this cycle? ALPHA-AF is not required during the cycle but can be used to help mitigate aromatization. Start with 1 capsule of Alpha-AF with your AM dose of Andros. Can this stack be taken for 8 weeks? Yes. We suggest running any Andro cycle for up to 8 weeks to maximize results. ALPHA-AF is required after all Andro use. How old must I be to take this stack? You must be at least 18 years old. Individuals under 21 are encouraged to use products such as PUMPED-AF, ADABOLIC, ADALOAD, ATP-FUSION, WHEY-PRO, WHEY-ISO, and VEG-PRO instead. Should I take this on rest days? Yes. Take Andros twice daily, even on rest days. Take ADABOLIC on off days to support recovery. N.O.7 may be used before active recovery sessions or cardiovascular activity. Can I combine this stack with other STEEL products? Yes. All STEEL products can be used alongside this stack. How many times can I take this stack? It is recommended not to exceed 8 weeks at a time. You can use products such as PRE, CHARGED-AF, HYPERADE, PUMPED-AF, and AMPED-AF with this stack. Does this stack contain any stimulants? No. This stack contains zero stimulants. Side effects? Because everyone’s body is different, individual experiences may vary. Proper dosing and liposomal technology help minimize potential side effects. Following your Andro cycle with Alpha-AF for PCT can further support hormonal balance and help maintain results. Do I need on-cycle therapy or liver support? No. On-cycle support is not required. Once tolerance has been established, up to 2 capsules may be used as directed. Primary Lane: Erection quality, firmness, healthy blood flow, arousal, stamina, drive, and confidence Best For: Adult men looking for targeted sexual-performance support without turning another product into an automatic daily supplement Active Formula Per 2-Capsule Serving: Vitamin B3 as Niacin — 50 mg Zinc as Zinc Orotate — 11 mg HARD-AF Vertical Blend — 1,010 mg HARD-AF Vertical Blend: Maca Powder, Whole Root Bryonia laciniosa Kaempferia parviflora (Rhizome) Korean Red Ginseng (Panax ginseng) Cinnamomum cassia (Bark) Epimedium brevicornum Eurycoma longifolia Root Extract Sodium Caprate Yohimbine HCl The HARD-AF Vertical Blend is a proprietary blend. Most male sexual-performance products focus only on desire, only on circulation, or an unfocused list of herbs. HARD-AF is built around the complete picture: erection quality, healthy blood flow, arousal, stamina, drive, and confidence. It supports the physical and mental sides of sexual performance without pretending that one capsule can replace cardiovascular health, hormone health, sleep, stress control, or medical care. Who HARD-AF Is For HARD-AF is designed for adult men who want targeted support for erection quality, firmness, healthy blood flow, arousal, stamina, drive, and sexual confidence. It is a strong fit for men who want a direct formula for use before sexual activity, men who want more than a basic single-ingredient product, and experienced Steel users who want an as-needed sexual-performance layer alongside a broader training or Andro plan. HARD-AF is not for minors, casual misuse, irresponsible stacking, or men looking for a product to conceal a persistent medical issue. The HARD-AF Sexual-Performance System Erection Quality + Healthy Blood Flow Healthy erectile response depends heavily on vascular function and blood-flow signaling. Korean Red Ginseng, Kaempferia parviflora, Epimedium brevicornum, and the broader blend support the formula’s firmness, fullness, circulation, and physical-readiness lane. Yohimbine HCl contributes a separate adrenergic, stimulant-like sexual-response component. Arousal + Drive Sexual response is not purely mechanical. Maca, Eurycoma longifolia, Korean Red Ginseng, Bryonia laciniosa, and Yohimbine HCl build the arousal, vitality, drive, and engagement side of the formula. title: HYPERADE
description: Ingredients Read the Science behind HYPERADE by Dr. Paul Henning Whether you’re lifting weights, training for a triathlon, skateboarding, riding motocross, or playing football, baseball, or hockey, the ability to adequately restore muscle glycogen and electrolytes simply cannot be done with food alone. HyperAde is designed to be taken pre-workout, intra-workout, and/or post-workout.HyperAde quickly replenishes muscle glycogen and electrolytes that are depleted from intense bursts of energy. Includes 25g of fast-digesting carbs from Cluster Dextrin, a superior carbohydrate that delivers smooth, constant energy and replenishes muscle glycogen storage without spiking blood sugar levels. This makes it more absorbable and readily available for your body to burn as energy.HyperAde is a non-stimulant electrolyte glycogen supplement that can be stacked with any of our other products. Fuel your most grueling training sessions and power your body to train longer and harder. HyperAde is the superior alternative to sugar-filled sports drinks, with a full profile of BCAAs and available in 3 delicious flavors. Backed by Science to Help Optimize: • Quickly Replenish Electrolytes* • Restore Muscle Glycogen* • Increase Performance* • Improve Endurance* • Fast Absorbing* • Stimulant-Free* How do I take HyperAde? As a dietary supplement, mix 1–2 scoops in 8–10 oz of water and take pre-workout, intra-workout, or post-workout. What is the difference between HyperAde and Adabolic? HyperAde focuses on rehydration, electrolyte replacement, and glycogen replenishment after intense activity. It contains 25g of ClusterDextrin to support endurance and performance. Adabolic focuses on vasodilation, nutrient partitioning, and amino-acid recovery. It contains 12g of GlycoMax to help create an insulin response and support strength and workout performance. For maximum results, HyperAde and Adabolic are designed to be used together. What separates HyperAde from dextrose powder or a sports drink? HyperAde combines the benefits of dextrose powders and sports drinks without the rapid sugar spike commonly associated with them. ClusterDextrin absorbs faster than complex carbohydrates while providing a steadier release than simple sugars, helping support recovery and glycogen replenishment more efficiently. When is the optimal time to take HyperAde? The best timing depends on your goals: Pre-workout: 1 scoop to maximize pumps and glycogen stores. During workout: Mix 1–2 scoops in 16–32 oz of water and sip throughout training to support endurance and performance. Post-workout: 1–2 scoops to enhance recovery and replenish glycogen. Can I take HyperAde with other products? Yes. HyperAde contains zero stimulants and can be combined with any STEEL product. For maximum pumps, consider pairing it with the HyperBolic Stack. For recovery, combine HyperAde with Adabolic and a protein powder for a complete post-workout solution. Cluster Dextrin, Glutamine, Leucine, L-Isoleucine, L-Valine, L-Lysine, L-Threonine, L-Methionine, L-Phenylaline, L-Trytophan, L-Histidine Other Ingredients: Natural & Artifcial Flavors, Citric Acid, Dipotassium Phosphate, Silicon Dioxide, Sucralose Product Video

If you miss a serving, do not double your next dose. Simply continue with your normal schedule at the next planned serving. How long can I cycle 3-EPI-Andro? Most users choose either a 4-week or 8-week cycle. Post-cycle support should be used after completing the cycle. Suggested use - How do I take 1 Andro? Take 1 tablet of 1-Andro in the morning on an empty stomach. Ideally, you do not want to eat for 30-60 minutes, but 30 minutes is sufficient. 10-12 hours later, take 1 tablet of 1-Andro on an empty stomach. You are going to repeat this for 4 to 8 weeks, depending on how long you choose to run your cycle. If you are using multiple Andros, simply follow the twice per day dosing schedule, and take your Andros together. How do I take multiple Andros at the same time? You take multiple Andros the same way you take individual Andros. Take 1 tablet of each Andro upon waking up, without food. Ideally, you do not want to consume food for the following 30-60 minutes. 10-12 hours later, take 1 tablet of each Andro without food, ideally waiting 30-60 minutes before consuming food. Repeat this for the length of the cycle. Does 1 Andro require liver support or on cycle therapy? Neither liver support nor on-cycle therapy is required, however, you will need to utilize Alpha-AF for PCT purposes, once you have finished your Andro cycle. The side effects range greatly from person to person. Genetics, lifestyle, eating habits and other variables all contribute to the side effects or lack of side effects users experience. For most, Alpha is perfect for restoring the hormonal balance of the body and ensuring the user keeps the majority of their new muscle gains. What is good to stack with 1 Andro? To maximize results, we suggest using Rested-AF for higher sleep quality, muscle recovery, and cognitive function day-to-day. We also suggest products such as ADAbolic and ADA-Load for optimized nutrient partitioning, muscle hydration, and caloric efficiency. Does it matter if I take them with food? You have slightly better absorption of the Andros on an empty stomach, but they still are effective even when taken with a small meal. How old must I be to take 1 Andro? You must be at least 18 years old. However, we do advise people under the age of 21 to stick to effective mass builders such as Pumped and ADABOLIC. Can women take 1 Andro? No. How long do I have to come off of the 1 Andro muscle hardener before getting back on? We operate under a time-on/time-off policy. If you run Andros for 4 weeks, take 4 weeks off (Alpha-AF PCT can be used for the 4 weeks off). If you run Andros for 8 weeks, take 8 weeks off (4 week cycle of Alpha-AF + additional 4 week break off all T modulators). Can 1 Andro be taken with other Steel products like Shredded? 1-Andro can be taken with ALL Steel products. We suggest waiting to take Alpha-AF until after you have completed your Andro cycle for PCT purposes. Can I drink alcohol on 1 Andro? We do not advise drinking alcohol on Andros, mainly because when we consume alcohol we suppress testosterone and the conversion of the Andros into testosterone. Refer to Dr. Paul Henning's article that takes a deep dive into athletic performance and alcohol What do I do if I forget to take a dose? Do not double up, just take 1 Andro when you can, and get back to your initial regimen. How long can I cycle 1 Andro for? You can choose between a 4 week cycle, or an 8 week cycle. Regardless of which cycle you decide, ensure that you run Alpha-AF for PCT purposes afterwards. 8 week cycles generally only require 1 bottle of Alpha-AF for PCT What products can be paired with Andros? Andros can be taken alongside PRE, Charged, Amped, Adabolic, Hyperade, Pumped, NO7, ATP-Fusion, Rested, BCAAS, ADA-Load Protein(Veg, Whey, Whey ISOI) 3-EPI-ANDRO 7 hydroxy-dehydroxepiandrosterone 25mg, Epiandrosterone 100mg Other Ingredients: Microcrystalline Cellulose, Phosphatidylcholine, Hydroxpropyl-beta-cyclodextrin (HPBCD), Phytosterol, Stearic Acid, Magnesium Stearate, Starch, Titanium Dioxide, Silica. 1-ANDRO 1-DHEA Other Ingredients: Microcrystalline Cellulose, Phosphatidycholine, Hydroxpropyl-beta-cyclodextrin (HPBCD), Phytosterol, Stearic Acid, Magnesium, Stearate, Starch, Titanium Dioxide, Silica, FD&C Red #40

title: Omni Energy - Case of 12 Cans
description: OMNI is the embodiment of what speaks to YOUR VIBE. The art tells a story and the flavors transport you there. Whether you're powering through a hard day at work, embarking on an adrenaline-fueled adventure, or simply seeking a revitalizing pick-me-up during a busy day, OMNI will energize you from the inside out to help you push past your limits, and embrace every moment of your day with unparalleled vigor.Each single flavor pack includes 12, 12oz. cans, the variety pack includes 4 cans of each flavor (12, 12oz. cans.) Beach Day: A sunrise on the beach is imbued with a different energy. Life begins as the sun breaks the horizon, shining on the waves, transforming the colors of the sky, as the sand absorbs its warmth. Being a part of this phenomenon fuels inspiration, hopefulness, and reminds us that today is a fresh start. For days you can't make it to the beach, open a can of OMNI and Vibe High.Stoked: There is an indescribable feeling when you catch the perfect wave. An undeniable synchronization between person and nature occurs, followed shortly by pure adrenaline and joy. Just as important as the thrill of the wave is having the courage to chase after it, and leave nothing behind when you find it. OMNI is about the chase; seeking the ultimate freedom and never shying away from it. Grab a can, and drop in.Corsa: Life comes at you fast, and doesn’t slow itself down. Revving through hairpin turns, staying on-track through chicanes and unexpected roadblocks, taking control often proves difficult. OMNI is the opportunity to put yourself in the driver's seat and set the pace. Crisp, clean flavors infused with smooth-riding energy & life-enhancing ingredients put you in control for the perfect podium finish. Island Gold: In a pirate’s paradise the gulf breeze sings,Among palms & sand where beauty springs,A princess spurned, his advances denied,Her bitter spirit haunts like the red tide,On this isle where legends sway,She stands watch o’er gold that grows all day Pineapple|MK2: Pull the pin on a tired afternoon with the explosive tropical flavor of Pineapple MK2. This flavor is mission-ready to ration our signature OMNI Energy blend, supplying you with energy, electrolytes, and b-vitamins.Georgia: A sweet miracle that soaks in the sun, flourishing into a juicy & refreshing experience. Take a sip and get whisked away to an orchard at peak-season, feeling the sun on your skin with a can of Georgia. Are there age restrictions for Omni Energy? Generally, we do not recommend this product for individuals under the age of 18. Is this product safe for pregnant women? Omni Energy is not recommended for women who are pregnant or breastfeeding. Can Omni be used as a pre-workout? OMNI may be used for pre-workout purposes. Each can provides 200mg of caffeine, 135mg of electrolytes, and 25mg of soothing L-Theanine. What are all of the Omni ingredients? Carbonated Water, Citric Acid, Sodium Citrate, Caffeine, Potassium Sorbate (Preservative), Ascorbic Acid (Vitamin C), Sucralose, Ginger Extract, Acesulfame Potassium, Potassium Citrate, Natural Flavor, L-Theanine, Niacinamide (Vitamin B3), Pyridoxine HCl (Vitamin B6), Folic Acid, Biotin, Vitamin B12. *Ingredient order may vary depending on flavor. What is the purpose of each active ingredient in the Omni Active Energy Blend? Caffeine - 200mg Active 200mg is roughly equivalent to 2–2.5 cups of coffee. The caffeine experience is smoother because it is paired with L-Theanine. This amount is designed to help you feel awake, focused, and present without excessive stimulation or anxiety. L-Theanine - 25mg Active Our caffeine-to-L-Theanine ratio is 8:1, which helps modulate the effects of caffeine. The result is a smoother and more relaxed energy experience compared to a typical energy drink or multiple cups of coffee. Ginger Root Extract - 5mg Active Ginger Root Extract helps support digestion and may reduce the feeling of bloating often associated with carbonated beverages. Caffeine - 200mg Active 200mg is roughly equivalent to 2–2.5 cups of coffee. The caffeine content at 200mg provides strong energy while pairing with the stimulant-modulating effects of L-Theanine. This amount is designed to help you feel awake, focused, and present without excessive stimulation or anxiety. Vitamin C - 90mg Active Every can of OMNI provides 100% of the Daily Value (DV) for Vitamin C to support immune health. Electrolytes - 135mg Active OMNI contains 135mg of electrolytes to support whole-body hydration and help replenish minerals that may be lost through sweat. L-Theanine - 25mg Active L-Theanine is an amino acid best known for its calming effects and is naturally found in tea leaves. It is the compound largely responsible for the smooth energy commonly associated with green tea. L-Theanine acts as a governor for caffeine by helping regulate how strongly caffeine stimulates the body over time. While it does not cancel out caffeine, it can help reduce the intensity of caffeine's stimulant effects, resulting in a smoother and more balanced energy experience. Ginger Root Extract - 5mg Active Ginger Root Extract may help relieve digestive discomfort caused by carbonation, promoting a smoother drinking experience and helping reduce bloating.

ONE+ is built for the foundation. Most people think about supplements backwards. They chase stronger pre-workouts, more advanced formulas, harder stacks, and more aggressive products before making sure the basics are covered. But your body runs on nutrients. Vitamins and minerals support energy metabolism, nervous system function, immune system function, red blood cell formation, antioxidant defenses, thyroid function, muscle function, cognitive function, and overall wellness. ONE+ gives users a simple daily way to support that foundation. The goal is not to replace food. The goal is to help fill gaps that can happen even when someone is trying to eat well. They help enzymes function, support energy production, support immune defenses, assist antioxidant systems, support hormone-related pathways, help maintain nervous system function, and contribute to overall health. The problem is that real life is not perfect. People skip meals. They eat the same foods over and over. They diet. They travel. They train hard. They sweat. They sleep poorly. They work long hours. ATP-FUSION supports daily creatine, cellular energy, hydration support, brain-energy support, and cognitive-performance routines. FOCUSED is the “lock in and execute” product. Product Roles Inside The Stack FOCUSED The nootropic energy and mental-performance driver. FOCUSED is Steel’s cognitive-performance formula, built for users who want mental clarity, focus, nootropic energy, memory support, mood support, visual-performance support, and a more locked-in state for work, studying, training, and high-output days. ATP-FUSION The daily creatine and brain-energy foundation. ATP-FUSION is built around micronized creatine monohydrate with sodium and potassium to help support creatine uptake, hydration, cellular energy, cognitive performance support, and long-term daily performance. Creatine is usually thought of as a strength and muscle-performance ingredient, but that is only part of the story. Creatine also helps support the body’s ATP system, which is central to cellular energy production. That matters for both physical output and cognitive performance because the brain is a high-demand organ that relies heavily on consistent energy availability. Use ATP-FUSION daily when the goal is creatine saturation, cellular energy support, cognitive performance support, hydration support, and a stronger brain-body performance foundation. Why Creatine Belongs In A Brain Stack Creatine is one of the most researched ingredients in sports nutrition, but its role goes beyond muscle. The body uses creatine to help support the ATP system, which is the energy currency behind high-demand cellular activity. The brain is one of the most energy-demanding organs in the body, which is why creatine has become increasingly relevant in discussions around cognitive performance, mental fatigue, sleep-deprivation stress, memory support, aging-related performance support, and brain-energy metabolism. That does not mean creatine is a stimulant. Creatine does not hit like caffeine. It does not create the immediate “on switch” feeling that a nootropic energy formula can provide. Instead, creatine works as a daily foundation. It helps support the energy system that both the brain and body depend on. That is why ATP-FUSION makes sense inside the Ultimate Brain Stack. It supports the background system: creatine saturation, cellular energy, hydration support, and cognitive-performance routines. FOCUSED helps support acute mental performance. ATP-FUSION helps support the daily brain-energy foundation. That combination is the point. Why The Ultimate Brain Stack Matters A lot of people treat focus like a caffeine problem. As you may know from our Veg-PRO, we want to make sure our protein flavors knock it out of the park, so we poured tons of hours into R&D time, trying various flavor combinations and are confident that you guys are going to love these as much as we do. STEEL's Veg-Pudding has been taste-tested extensively by adults and kids. So, mom and dad, if you have a picky-eater and struggle to help get them enough protein throughout the day, we have you covered. How do I take Veg-Pudding? Adults (Ages 12+): Mix 1 scoop of pudding in 4–5oz of cold water (or liquid of choice) and stir vigorously. Liquid can be increased or decreased to achieve the desired consistency. Children (Ages 5–11): Mix ½ scoop of pudding in 2oz of cold water (or liquid of choice) and stir vigorously. Liquid can be increased or decreased to achieve the desired consistency. Is this safe for kids? Absolutely. Veg-Pudding is formulated free of the most common food allergens and is gentle on digestive systems. If your child has specific medical or nutritional concerns, consult your pediatrician before introducing new foods. Can I still use protein powders such as Whey Pro, Iso, or Veg-PRO with Veg-Pudding? Yes. There are no negative interactions with any of our protein powders or other STEEL products. You can incorporate Veg-Pudding as another convenient way to help meet your daily protein goals alongside any other STEEL supplements you are using. Chocolate: Organic Pea Protein Isolate, Organic Brown Rice Protein, Waxy Corn Starch, Cocoa (Processed with Alkali), Shortening Powder, Natural Flavors, Low DE Maltodextrin, Potassium Chloride, Disodium Phosphate, Xanthan Gum, Steviol Glycoside 95%, Sucralose Product Video

Whether your goal is building muscle, leaning out, improving recovery, or simply hitting your daily protein target, WHEY-PRO is designed to make consistency easier. This is not a complicated product. That is the point. WHEY-PRO gives you a quality protein source, strong flavor options, smooth mixability, and a simple daily tool to help support the foundation of any serious fitness plan: enough protein, every day. Built To Support Muscle growth Recovery after training Daily protein intake Strength-focused nutrition Lean-mass support Satiety between meals Higher-protein meal structure Cutting, bulking, recomp, and maintenance phases Formula Snapshot Formula Type: Whey protein powderProtein: 20g per scoopPrimary Protein Source: Whey protein concentratePrimary Lane: Muscle support, recovery, satiety, and daily protein intakeBest For: Lifters, athletes, busy professionals, hardgainers, people dieting, and anyone who needs a simple way to increase daily protein intake What Makes WHEY-PRO Different? WHEY-PRO is built around simplicity, taste, mixability, and consistency. Most people do not fail their nutrition plan because protein is complicated. They fail because they do not get enough of it consistently. WHEY-PRO helps solve that problem by giving you an easy, great-tasting protein option that can be used after training, between meals, before bed, or anytime you need a convenient protein boost. Protein is the foundation. Training breaks the body down. Nutrition helps build it back up. WHEY-PRO gives you a simple way to support that process every day. Which Steel Protein Should You Choose? Steel offers multiple protein options because not every athlete needs the same protein source. The right choice depends on your digestion, nutrition goals, taste preference, and how strict you want to be with carbs, fats, and dairy. Choose WHEY-PRO if you want a great-tasting everyday whey protein with a smooth, creamy texture and 20g of protein per scoop. WHEY-PRO is ideal for users who want an easy daily protein option for muscle support, recovery, satiety, and consistency. Because it uses whey protein concentrate, it may naturally contain slightly more carbohydrates, fat, and lactose than WHEY-ISO, but many users prefer it for taste, texture, and drinkability. Choose WHEY-ISO if you want a leaner, more filtered whey protein option with lower carbs, lower fat, and less lactose. WHEY-ISO is a strong choice for users who are dieting, tracking macros closely, sensitive to heavier whey formulas, or looking for a cleaner protein source around training. Choose Veg-Pro if you want a plant-based protein option without whey or dairy. Veg-Pro is best for users who avoid dairy, prefer vegan protein, or want a plant-based alternative to traditional whey protein. Simple breakdown: WHEY-PRO: best for taste, creaminess, everyday protein, and consistency. WHEY-ISO: best for leaner macros, lower carbs, lower fat, and lighter digestion. Veg-Pro: best for plant-based, dairy-free protein support. No matter which protein you choose, the goal is the same: hit your daily protein target consistently. The best protein is the one that fits your body, your goals, and your routine. Key Benefits Muscle Growth SupportProtein provides the amino acids your body needs to support muscle repair, recovery, and growth after training. WHEY-PRO helps make it easier to hit the daily protein intake required to support lean mass and strength. Recovery SupportHard training increases the demand for protein. WHEY-PRO can be used after workouts or throughout the day to help support recovery and the rebuilding process. Satiety + Meal SupportProtein can help support fullness and better meal structure. WHEY-PRO can be used between meals, blended into a smoothie, or paired with oats, fruit, nut butter, or other foods depending on your goal. Taste + MixabilityProtein only works if you actually use it. WHEY-PRO is built to taste good, mix easily, and fit into real life. Shake it with water, milk, or blend it into oats, smoothies, yogurt, or recipes when you need an easy protein boost. Lean NutritionWHEY-PRO is built to support protein intake without unnecessary carbohydrates, making it useful during cutting, recomp, lean-mass, and maintenance phases. How To Use WHEY-PRO Mix 1 scoop with water, milk, or your preferred beverage. Use anytime you need additional protein. Best Times To Use Post-Workout: Use after training to support recovery and muscle repair. Between Meals: Use as a high-protein snack to help support satiety and daily protein intake. Morning: Use with breakfast or in a smoothie to start the day with more protein. Before Bed: Use when you need additional protein later in the day. During A Cut: Use to help keep protein high while calories are controlled. During A Bulk: Use to help reach higher daily protein targets without adding another full meal. Best Used For Building Muscle: Use WHEY-PRO alongside progressive resistance training, sufficient calories, and consistent protein intake to support lean mass and strength. Cutting / Fat Loss: Use WHEY-PRO to help keep protein intake high while calories are controlled. The goal is not just to lose weight. The goal is to support muscle while body fat comes down. Recomp: Use WHEY-PRO to support protein consistency while training hard and improving body composition. Busy Schedules: Use WHEY-PRO when you need a fast, convenient protein option and do not have time for a full meal. Stack Recommendations Muscle Growth StackWHEY-PRO + ADABOLICBest for users who want daily protein support plus stimulant-free training-window fuel, pumps, hydration, endurance, and recovery support. Advanced Hypertrophy StackWHEY-PRO + HYPERBOLICBest for users who want daily protein support plus a more advanced pre, intra, and post-workout performance system with protein, carbs, creatine, pumps, hydration, cellular energy, and nutrient-uptake support. Cutting StackWHEY-PRO + SHREDDEDBest for users cutting calories who want to keep protein high while supporting energy, appetite control, thermogenesis, and fat-loss execution. Strength + Lean Mass StackWHEY-PRO + 1-ANDROBest for experienced users using a structured lean-mass cycle who want to keep protein intake consistent while supporting strength, density, and lean mass. Nutrition Guidance Protein works best when the rest of the plan makes sense. For best results, pair WHEY-PRO with: Consistent resistance training Adequate total daily protein Goal-appropriate calories Hydration Sleep and recovery A nutrition plan you can actually stick to WHEY-PRO is not magic. It is a tool. Use it to make the basics easier: train hard, eat enough protein, recover, and repeat. Allergen + Gluten Note Contains milk. Manufactured in a facility that also processes common food allergens. Peanut Butter Cookies & Cream is not gluten-free. All other WHEY-PRO flavors are gluten-free. Important Use Notice Use as directed. Do not use if you are allergic or sensitive to milk or whey protein. Consult a qualified healthcare professional before use if you have any medical condition, are pregnant or nursing, or take prescription medications. Final Note WHEY-PRO is the daily protein workhorse. It supports the foundation of the plan: muscle, recovery, satiety, and consistency. Whether you are building, cutting, recomping, or just trying to stop missing your protein target, WHEY-PRO makes it easier to get the job done. How do I take Whey-PRO? Mix 1 scoop of Whey-PRO in 6–8 oz of water and shake vigorously. Each serving provides 20 grams of protein. When is the best time to take Whey-PRO? There is never a bad time to increase your protein intake, but for optimal results we recommend taking Whey-PRO within an hour after your workout to take advantage of your anabolic window. Whey-PRO can also be used as a convenient, nutrient-rich snack between meals. Is Whey Protein Concentrate difficult to digest? Whey-PRO is formulated with high-quality protein sources and includes Papain and Lactase to help support digestion and improve overall tolerance. What is the difference between Whey-PRO, Whey-ISO, and Veg-PRO? Whey-ISO is lactose-free and filtered for fast digestion. Whey-PRO is filtered but contains traces of dairy and has a thicker consistency. Veg-PRO is plant-based and ideal for those with sensitive stomachs or who prefer a vegan protein option. Why would I choose Whey-PRO over Whey-ISO? Whey-PRO combines Whey Protein Isolate and Whey Protein Concentrate, creating a slower-digesting protein blend that may help keep you feeling satisfied for longer. The additional nutrients naturally found in Whey Protein Concentrate may also provide added nutritional benefits compared to a pure isolate formula. Other Ingredients (Vanilla Cream Pie): Whey protein Concentrate, Non-dairy Creamer, Naturally & artificially flavored, xanthan gum, salt, sucralose, aceulfame-k, lactase, papain. *ingredients may vary between flavors.
